C0391.title: Finding a “Money-Making Scheme” in “Zombie Stores”
C0391.summary: In 2025, a young man named Xiao Lin exploited a loophole in Tmall's platform rules by identifying unattended “zombie stores” that would not ship orders. He placed bulk orders and then filed complaints demanding compensation for delayed or out-of-stock shipments, draining the store deposits. Over 100 Tmall stores nationwide had their deposits emptied, with total losses exceeding 1 million yuan and
